purpose: A descriptive-only reference layer derived 1:1 from the boundary-case corpus. It reorganizes what the corpus already records into a citable, machine-processable index. It is NOT ranking, scoring, recommendation, conformance, certification, or a new sport/not-sport verdict.
governing_principle: The Atlas must expose what the corpus knows, not manufacture what the corpus does not know.
derivation_rule: Every descriptive value MUST be copied from the source boundary case. No value may be inferred, averaged, scored, or re-judged. Per-field claim_class and status are preserved exactly as recorded in the source.

identifier_policy.format: ATL-D-NNN where NNN is the zero-padded source boundary-case number
identifier_policy.binding: Each atlas_record_id binds to exactly one source_case_id (ATL-D-001 -> BC-001). The binding is locked in ATLAS_ID_LOCK_V0.1.json and must not be silently repointed.
identifier_policy.citability: Atlas records are NOT added to CITATION_REGISTRY_V0.1.json in v0.1. Registry integration (external citability of ATL-D-* ids) is a separate, deliberate governed step; citability is not assumed automatically.

license.basis: Derived solely from the CC BY 4.0 licensed boundary-case corpus (DATASET_LICENSE.md). It does not incorporate the blocked ASR normative clause text (LICENSE-ASR-001).

dimension_field_note: Each status-bearing dimension preserves at least {status, claim_class, summary} plus the source's controlled lists (agency_modes, interface_types, demand_types, operational_spatial_integration.functions). operational_spatial_integration preserves {overall_status, profile_status, immersion_present, functions[]}. human_limits_accessibility preserves the source L9 safety/accessibility note. participatory_actor_relations preserves the source list verbatim (may be empty).
provenance_rule: C1/C2 = documented/synthesized fact; C3 = attributed external/provider claim; C4/C5 = Altis analytical/provisional interpretation; C6 = commercial/forecast. Provider claims are carried in evidence_sources and (where present) the source institutional recognition; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5. source_provisional_finding is the source corpus's own attributed reading, preserved verbatim with its claim_class — it is NOT a new Atlas verdict.

prohibited_fields.rule: No Atlas-introduced evaluative field may appear anywhere in a record.

human_readable_derivation: ATLAS_DESCRIPTIVE_V0.1.md is generated from the same builder and the same records. It must never be hand-edited independently.
gaps_and_blockers: Atlas v0.1 depends only on the boundary corpus; it does not depend on BLOCKER-OPREVIEW-BASELINE-001 or on the blocked ASR clauses (LICENSE-ASR-001).
Any future need for a field not present in the corpus must be recorded here as a proposed_field, not silently added to a stable schema.
